biography.plain_text: Simon Elliott is the Texas-based founder and owner of Active Deployment Systems, which provides temporary facilities for emergencies, military training and commercial events. He developed the business within his mother's and stepfather's sanitation company before separating its specialist trailer operation. A Texas A&M graduate, he built ADS around mobile hygiene services.

long_biography.plain_text:
Simon Elliott approached emergency sanitation as an equipment-design problem. After Hurricane Katrina, he sketched a restroom trailer with a ruler and graph paper, adapting vacuum technology used aboard cruise ships. His early development work involved specialist advice as well as practical trials, including lending a prototype to the military without charge.

At a California disaster-response exercise, Elliott offered another unit free if organisers arranged local servicing. He attended to demonstrate the equipment and collect feedback while an employee remained to monitor it. The trailer ran on generators and holding tanks, allowing it to operate without connections to public utilities.
